name: web-grocery-marketplace-product-detail-page
title: Grocery Product Detail with Store Comparison
whatItIs: A product page in a macOS window frame: deep teal rounded header with search, a large product image on a pale tile with thumbnails, price with superscript cents, Klarna row, lime Buy now button, urgency countdown and a list comparing stores by price and delivery time.
whatItMeans: Deep teal with lime feels fresh and food-related, while the dense but ordered layout signals a fast, practical marketplace.
techniques: Superscript decimals on prices for a distinct numeric style
Lime pill CTA as the loudest element against teal and white
Countdown and sold-recently badges for urgency
Store comparison rows that put price and delivery time side by side
Rounded pale tile behind the product image
bestFor: Any product page needing trust and urgency cues

vocabulary.definition: Cents set small and raised beside the dollar amount.
Countdowns or sales counters encouraging a quick decision.
Rows comparing sellers on price and delivery.
